title: Best Bikini Trimmers UK
short: Five bikini trimmers tested for closeness, smoothness and irritation, from an £18 travel-sized pick to an £82 premium groomer.
intro: A bikini trimmer is designed for the sensitive skin around the bikini line, smaller and gentler than a regular electric shaver, and less painful there than an epilator. This guide is based on Expert Reviews' tested roundup, where each trimmer was used as directed, testing different lengths and wet/dry settings where available, then judged on closeness of trim, smoothness afterwards, nicks or irritation, extras included and ease of cleaning. Prices are as reviewed.

products.name: BikiniGenie Trimmer BRT383/15
products.best_for: Combining gentle trimming with a bare, close shave option
products.key_spec: 0-5mm cutting range, 2 click-on combs (3mm, 5mm) plus 0mm shaving head, wet and dry, AA battery
products.summary: Expert Reviews found this practical Philips tool works well for neat trims and smooth shaves: two combs give uniform trimming at 3mm and 5mm, while the mini shaving head trims to 0mm, combining the gentleness of a bikini trimmer with the precision of a standard razor. It's compact enough for hand luggage and comes with a pouch and cleaning brush, though the AA battery isn't rechargeable and the attachments, while easy to swap, aren't hugely effective.
pros: Gentle shaves with uniform trimming combs
Mini shaving head gives a bare, close shave

products.name: True Smooth Wet and Dry Bikini Trimmer
products.best_for: Simple, budget-friendly trimming without extra frills
products.key_spec: 0-4mm cutting range, 2 combs, wet and dry, 2 x AAA batteries included
products.summary: Expert Reviews found this affordable, effective and simple to use, calling it their best all-rounder. It's best used without the attachments for the smoothest shave, especially to combat shaving bumps and ingrown hairs, and comes fully loaded with batteries so there's nothing extra to buy. It's less compact than pricier bikini trimmers on the list, and the peach colourway won't suit everyone.
pros: Affordable, effective and simple to use
Close shave when used without attachments
cons: Less compact than other trimmers on the list
products.search: BaByliss True Smooth Wet and Dry Bikini Trimmer

products.name: Body Mini Trimmer
products.best_for: A slimline, portable trimmer for holidays and weekend trips
products.key_spec: 0-4mm cutting range, 13cm long, 1 comb, wet and dry, 100% waterproof, 1 x AA battery
products.summary: Expert Reviews found a compact trimmer, just 13cm long, with a small head that follows the body's contours even in tricky areas. One 4mm comb is enough for most trimming needs, and it can be used wet or dry, runs on a single included AA battery, and comes with a cleaning brush. It's an excellent compact product for beach holidays or a weekend travel kit.
pros: Follows body contours even in tricky areas
Fully waterproof, usable wet or dry
cons: Battery powered, only one comb length

products.name: The Trimmer Plus
products.best_for: Anyone who wants adjustable lengths and long battery life for all body hair
products.key_spec: 0.2-4mm cutting range, 4 adjustable comb lengths, ceramic blades, waterproof, 90-minute rechargeable battery, LED light
products.summary: Expert Reviews found a wet/dry trimmer suitable for tidying all body hair, from underarm to bikini or torso, with ceramic blades offering a smooth, nick-free finish and a head that fits comfortably into bodily nooks and crannies. It feels nicely balanced in the hand, is fully waterproof for shower use, and the rechargeable battery lasts up to 90 minutes with a colour-matching charging dock. The ceramic blade needs replacing every few months, at £20 (or £18 on a subscription).
pros: Adjustable comb length from 1mm to 4mm, or bare
Ceramic blades give a smooth, nick-free finish
cons: Blade needs replacing every few months, an ongoing cost

products.name: Trimmer Kit Face and Body
products.best_for: Anyone who wants one rechargeable tool for bikini, eyebrows and facial hair
products.key_spec: 0.1-12mm cutting range, 3 attachments (rotary face trimmer, eyebrow, body/bikini), rechargeable, 60-minute battery, dry only
products.summary: Expert Reviews found this a versatile tool at a decent price: a gentle rotary trimmer smooths the face without nicking delicate skin, an eyebrow attachment tidies arches, and a trimmer attachment covers underarm and bikini areas. Attachments are easy to change and it comes with a cleaning brush and storage bag. The results on face and body were good, with a smooth finish and no tugging or nicking, though the rose gold tool feels a little light and plasticky in the hand.
pros: Versatile: covers bikini, body, eyebrows and face
Smooth finish with no tugging or nicking
cons: Feels a little light and plasticky in the hand
products.search: Wahl Trimmer Kit Face and Body

guide.a: Electric trimmers tend to work best on dry skin, where dry hairs stand up for a closer cut and are easier to clean off the trimmer. Wet and dry models, like the Philips BikiniGenie, BaByliss True Smooth, Braun Body Mini and Meridian Trimmer Plus, are convenient for trimming quickly in the shower and can be rinsed under running water.

guide.q: How do I avoid irritation and ingrown hairs?
guide.a: Because trimmers cut hair rather than pulling it out, ingrown hairs are more likely than with waxing or epilating. Expert Reviews recommends gently exfoliating before shaving, moisturising afterwards, keeping blades clean and sharp, and shaving in the direction of hair growth to reduce irritation.

Rechargeable models, like the Meridian Trimmer Plus (90 minutes) and Wahl Trimmer Kit (60 minutes), avoid the ongoing cost of batteries. Battery-powered options like the Philips BikiniGenie, BaByliss True Smooth and Braun Body Mini are cheaper upfront but need regular battery changes.

guide.q: Do I need a multipurpose trimmer?
guide.a: If you also want to tidy eyebrows or facial hair, the Wahl Trimmer Kit and Meridian Trimmer Plus both extend beyond the bikini line to other body areas. If you just want a dedicated bikini trimmer, a simpler model like the BaByliss True Smooth or Braun Body Mini keeps things focused.
